claim_updates.reason: Within-stratum conditional permutation fails to center null at zero for hash-routed SPA: null_mean=0.417 bits (|0.417| > 0.1 threshold, 4.17x above limit). The frozen decision_rule condition C4 triggers FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING. This is a valid negative on the null-control methodology, not on the beyond-Markov signal (K2 PMI=0.933 bits, p=0.001). The convergence of within-stratum (0.417) and action-shuffle (0.406) null means suggests intrinsic PMI estimator bias floor ~0.41 bits at N=5000 for deterministic/stochastic mixed SPAs. Phase 2 production testing precluded by Phase 1 falsification. Claim ceiling unchanged: HYPOTHESIS pending alternative null framework that centers null at zero.
